theater_event_25_04_14_002:
We talked too long. I never meant to say
this much... Guess I got more fired up than
I expected. Alfia's going to kill me.
theater_event_25_04_14_003:
Alfia...? And she's going to k-kill you...?
I don't really understand, but...
theater_event_25_04_14_004:
...I had fun too. I'm not sure why.
You yelled at me the whole time...but it felt warm.
theater_event_25_04_14_007:
If the next place we meet is a battlefield,
I will kill you.
theater_event_25_04_14_009:
There's something I have to accomplish.
You must have something too. Neither of us
needs to question the other's resolve.
theater_event_25_04_14_010:
We'll just devour each other. Kill each other.
Remember that much.
theater_event_25_04_14_012:
If we're going to fight to the death next time,
why would you do this?! You're scary and weird,
but somehow you're kind, too!
theater_event_25_04_14_013:
If I eat food a person like that made for me,
I won't be able to fight you!
Why?! Why would you do this?!
theater_event_25_04_14_014:
I did it because I wanted to. That's all.
Right now I'm not "justice"... I'm "evil."
theater_event_25_04_14_015:
I devour whatever I hunger for. Food,
and every life that isn't my own. If you say
you won't forgive that, come and kill me.
theater_event_25_04_14_020: ...Grow up big, you little brat. Bell.
theater_event_25_04_14_021:
According to Bell's information, there are four
days left until the final clash of good and evil...
theater_event_25_04_14_022:
Just like the "Seven Days of Death," we can
assume things are unfolding the same way here.
theater_event_25_04_14_023:
Yes. On the first day of the Great Feud, we did
all we could to minimize damage on the surface,
so we couldn't split up our forces.
theater_event_25_04_14_024:
Erebus, the Absolute Evil, is surely up to no good
down in the deep floors to summon the "Calamity."
We'll just have to let that one go.
theater_event_25_04_14_025:
If anything, it'll be easier to steer things
toward the finish line—day seven. For now,
watching while probing beneath the surface works.
theater_event_25_04_14_026:
Agreed. The Warlord's group keeps training to
break through their walls, and Braver is
getting ready for battle too—
theater_event_25_04_14_027:
Excuse me... Lord Hermes, Lady Astraea.
Do you have a moment?
theater_event_25_04_14_028:
Of course. But...did something happen?
You look troubled. Just like the first time
I met you.
theater_event_25_04_14_029:
...What happened to the "Knossos Key"
I gave you before?
theater_event_25_04_14_030:
...I delivered it to Braver. But it doesn't look
like he'll use it. Attacking the enemy's base
at this stage is too risky.
theater_event_25_04_14_031:
But we're deliberately leaking word that
the key is in our hands. If that pressures
the enemy and splits their forces, all the better.
theater_event_25_04_14_032:
So...
I can't let you use the key right now, Bell.
theater_event_25_04_14_034:
Can you tell us? Why you wanted to use
the key, and what's weighing on you now?
theater_event_25_04_14_035:
...I want to know about Mr. Zald and Ms. Alfia.
If possible, I was hoping I could see them...
theater_event_25_04_14_036:
They're impossibly strong and terrifying,
but I feel so strange about them. Lady Astraea,
do you know anything about them...?
theater_event_25_04_14_037:
..."The symbol of the Age of Gods" and "the pinnacle
of a god's familia." That's what they called the
Zeus and Hera Familias, and among them,
theater_event_25_04_14_038:
Zald and Alfia helped slay the Behemoth, King
of the Land, and the Leviathan, Lord of the Sea.
That's all I know. Not why they turned to evil.
theater_event_25_04_14_039:
...Same here. If you want to know more,
should I dig around for you?
theater_event_25_04_14_041:
So "future me" never told him about his
connection with Alfia and the others, huh?
Yeah, I couldn't. Not easily, anyway.
theater_event_25_04_14_043:
I wanted him lying low on purpose, like the key,
to keep pressure on the enemy...
but that looks like a tall order.
theater_event_25_04_15_002:
Where were you yesterday? I got to be with Lion,
but I couldn't see you, so I was lonely, you know?
theater_event_25_04_15_003:
...I'm sorry, Ms. Ardee.
There was just something on my mind...
theater_event_25_04_15_004:
...Hmmm. So you're keeping secrets?
Al won't tell me, huh~?
theater_event_25_04_15_005:
Al. You were out on the front lines, weren't you?
Fighting the Evilus all night long.
theater_event_25_04_15_006:
Urk...?!
H-how do you know that...?
theater_event_25_04_15_007:
My big sister told me. She said someone
dressed as a Jester was backing up the adventurers.
theater_event_25_04_15_008:
If you're going to push yourself that hard,
I'm joining the front lines too! Amid healed me,
so I can move just fine now!
theater_event_25_04_15_010: Al... You haven't been sleeping again, have you?
theater_event_25_04_15_012:
Same as three months ago. You don't rest at all,
and you just get more and more worn down...
I hate watching you fight all alone.
theater_event_25_04_15_013:
Hey, Al, are we really that unreliable?
Can't we stand beside you, strong as you are,
or at least have your back?
theater_event_25_04_15_014:
...That's not it, Ms. Ardee. It's different
from before... It's not like I'm trying to
handle everything on my own...
theater_event_25_04_15_015:
I'm looking for some people...
I want to see them again and hear them out...
theater_event_25_04_15_016:
Sister Dina! The Jester showed up!
We finally found him!
theater_event_25_04_15_017:
Marvelous, Vena!
Where was our favorite little piece of trash—
I mean, our favorite doll?
theater_event_25_04_15_018:
Oh, Sister! You can't hide your true feelings!
The Jester appeared on last night's battlefield!
theater_event_25_04_15_019:
He cleaned up every last bit of Valletta's
"harassment," and he looked like he was
searching for something!
theater_event_25_04_15_020:
What could he be looking for? Could we steal it?
Snatch it, tear it, stomp it, and squash it
into a mushy mess?!
theater_event_25_04_15_021:
What a lovely idea! We're so curious about the
Jester that we haven't been able to kill—I mean,
love—Hedin and Hogni at all!
theater_event_25_04_15_022:
We could lie in wait at the night's ballroom—
the battlefield! Or search from the balcony—
the city wall—where the moon is close!
theater_event_25_04_15_023:
I'd prefer the romantic balcony! The ballroom
has far too many adventurer-maggots
swarming around us!
theater_event_25_04_15_024:
You can't hide your true feelings either, Vena!
Ahahaha! But yes, the King of Evil Gods did
tell us to keep quiet—
theater_event_25_04_15_025:
—so let's search. For the Jester's
precious "flower."
theater_event_25_04_16_001:
Gaaah! Finally, a break! They kept us chained
to the front forever... Anybody can see
we're way overworked, y'know?
theater_event_25_04_16_002:
We're shorthanded, so it can't be helped.
To show what "justice" is, we must be
the people's shield right now.
theater_event_25_04_16_003:
For someone who was moping until just recently,
you've perked right up... Did Big Sister Ardee
give you a pat on the head? Hm?
theater_event_25_04_16_004:
K-Kaguya, you...!! Ardee is not my sister,
and she has n-not patted me on the head!
Take it back!!
theater_event_25_04_16_005:
...Oh? Speak of the devil.
Ardee! What are you doing out here?
theater_event_25_04_16_006:
Alise... And everyone else, too...
Are you rotating off the line?
theater_event_25_04_16_007:
Yes, but...you look a little down.
If something's bothering you,
I'm happy to lend an ear♪
theater_event_25_04_16_008: Something's off with Al, you say?
theater_event_25_04_16_009:
Not so much "off," but...
he seems to have something on his mind.
theater_event_25_04_16_010:
And so you want to cheer him up? You and Lion
both fuss over him far too much.
theater_event_25_04_16_011:
Just leave men alone. Hand him some money
and let him roam free, and he'll recover
soon enough.
theater_event_25_04_16_012:
And you're way too extreme, as usual.
Did Al say anything else?
theater_event_25_04_16_013:
Um... He said, "There are people
I want to see"...I think...
theater_event_25_04_16_018:
Nope, Kaguya's right, can't defend him.
When a guy gets all sappy about "wanting to see"
someone, it's a woman. That's the rule.
theater_event_25_04_16_019:
N-no way...! So Al really is a womanizer
and a "lolicon" after all...?!
theater_event_25_04_16_020:
The scoundrel. Behind that harmless face,
he's a lecher after all. We need to act fast.
theater_event_25_04_16_021:
Don't worry, Ardee! As an apostle of justice
and a maiden of the stars, I have a secret plan!
Just do what I tell you to Al, and you'll be fine!
theater_event_25_04_16_022:
Whaaaat...?! Y-you want me to do that?!
Will that really fix anything...?!
theater_event_25_04_16_023: ...Have you all forgotten we're at war?
theater_event_25_04_16_024:
(...That's what I told Ms. Ardee, but what
 am I going to do if I actually see them?)
theater_event_25_04_16_025:
(They're the enemy... And in my world, they were
 defeated by Ms. Ryu and the others. They should
 have been. Even if I learn something...)
theater_event_25_04_16_026:
...The church home.
Right, seven years ago, it's still standing...
theater_event_25_04_16_027:
The goddess isn't here, but...
I may as well stop by.
theater_event_25_04_16_029:
You and I will never meet again.
I believe that is what I foretold.
theater_event_25_04_16_031:
You broke my rule.
Surely you will pay the price for disgracing me—
theater_event_25_04_16_033:
I think you meant we'd never meet again
"on the battlefield," so...
S-so it doesn't count?
theater_event_25_04_16_034:
...Very well. Then I have not been disgraced,
and what I said was not wrong. Correct?
theater_event_25_04_16_036: Why...did you come to this church?
theater_event_25_04_16_037:
...It was a place my sister loved.
That is why I came.
theater_event_25_04_16_038:
(Ms. Alfia has a sister...?
 "Loved"... Does that mean she's already...?)
theater_event_25_04_16_039:
...Ms. Alfia, why are you fighting Orario?
Why would you side with evil—
theater_event_25_04_16_040:
Why should I answer you? Never mind that—
be silent. Do not defile this church's peace.
theater_event_25_04_16_041:
Huh...?
Um, I just want to know about you and Mr. Zald—
theater_event_25_04_16_042: I told you to hold your tongue.
theater_event_25_04_16_044:
(...Is she praying? She's just standing there
 with her eyes closed...but that's how it looks.)
theater_event_25_04_16_045: (This place really must be important to her...)
theater_event_25_04_16_046:
I am about to do something foolish.
Answer me one thing.
theater_event_25_04_16_047:
Huh...?
B-but you said you wouldn't answer anything...
theater_event_25_04_16_048:
I will not answer. You will.
I have decided it, so obey.
theater_event_25_04_16_050:
Suppose "meeting the one you long for
would destroy the world"—
what would you do?
theater_event_25_04_16_051:
The one I long for...? And the world
would be destroyed...?
theater_event_25_04_16_052:
Do I chase my own selfish wish, or hold back
for everyone's sake...? Is that what you mean?
That kind of choice is...
theater_event_25_04_16_053: A waste of time. I should not have asked.
theater_event_25_04_16_054:
I made my choice.
...That is all.
theater_event_25_04_17_001:
(What was Ms. Alfia trying to say...?
 What kind of answer did she want from me?)
theater_event_25_04_17_002: Why does it bother me this much...?
theater_event_25_04_17_003: —Filth of the mortal world!! Don't you move!!
theater_event_25_04_17_004:
Huh?! S-Syr...?
Is that really you, Syr?! Whaaat?!
theater_event_25_04_17_005:
Because of you, the exalted goddess... And then
you went and defiled me too...! I'll end you!
However I'm punished, you die here!!
theater_event_25_04_17_008:
Whoa?! A-Ais?! So cute—wait, no!
Why now of all times?!
theater_event_25_04_17_009:
D-don't...don't you dare, don't you dare!
What is with that difference in attitude?!
theater_event_25_04_17_010:
Call us "cute" too, and pat our heads!!
And then die in my arms!!!
theater_event_25_04_17_011:
What is going on with your emotions
and personality?!
theater_event_25_04_17_012:
Mr. Bunny, fluffy, silky...
Can I climb up on your shoulders again?
theater_event_25_04_17_013:
Aiiis?! You're adorably spacey as ever, but can
you see what's happening?! This is a bloodbath!
S-somebody heeelp!!
theater_event_25_04_17_014:
Oh! Al's being cornered by a little girl and a
waitress! And one's got a knife! This must be...
a lovers' quarrel!!
theater_event_25_04_17_016:
Keeping one woman on the side and two-timing
with a little kid... That's messed up. Honestly,
how big a player is that guy?
theater_event_25_04_17_017: Isn't he the real Absolute Evil?
theater_event_25_04_17_018:
Stop talking nonsense, we have to break this up!
At this rate, somebody's going to get stabbed!!
theater_event_25_04_17_019:
Wait, Lion! This is your moment, Ardee!
Now's the time to set my secret plan ablaze!!
theater_event_25_04_17_020:
Whaaaaaaaat...?! Seriously?!
This is definitely not the time, is it?!
theater_event_25_04_17_021:
At this rate Al's going to end up full of holes!
Trust me! Love and justice save everything!
Love and justiiice!!
theater_event_25_04_17_022:
Uuuuuuugh...! If this keeps up, Al's going to...!
Here goes!
theater_event_25_04_17_028:
Al's going to fall for me, fall for me!
He's going to love me~!
theater_event_25_04_17_031:
Aaaaaaaaah?!
This is way too embarrassing!!
theater_event_25_04_17_033:
Say something, Aaal?!
Sword Princess, waitress, stop looking at me
like that!!
theater_event_25_04_17_034:
—Sorry, Ardee.
Looks like I got that a little wrong! *Wink*☆
theater_event_25_04_17_036:
Uuugh...!
I've lost so many important things...
theater_event_25_04_17_037:
Ahaha... W-well, you saved me. Thanks to you,
things got so awkward that the whole mess
just fizzled out...
theater_event_25_04_17_038:
Don't call it awkward!
I am never doing anything like that again!!
theater_event_25_04_17_039:
...Al, those people you wanted to see...
did you get to see them?
theater_event_25_04_17_040:
...I did. But I didn't find out what I wanted to.
No... Maybe I didn't even know what
I wanted to find out...
theater_event_25_04_17_041:
...Ms. Ardee, how far do you think
"justice" goes?
theater_event_25_04_17_043:
There are people who call themselves "evil,"
and they're doing wrong things. When we're
the ones who have to call ourselves "justice,"
theater_event_25_04_17_044:
I don't know at all what "justice" can do,
or how far it's allowed to go...
theater_event_25_04_17_045:
...Al, you don't want to fight those people
who call themselves "evil," do you?
You want to forgive them.
theater_event_25_04_17_046:
......But if someone's going to get hurt,
I have to fight. Whatever their reasons, if
they take something precious from someone...
theater_event_25_04_17_047:
Al. I worry about "justice" a lot too,
with Lion and the others.
And you know what? When I'm lost...I think this:
theater_event_25_04_17_050:
Yeah! I wonder what kind of comedy
"the First Hero" would turn the tragedy into!
theater_event_25_04_17_051:
In ancient times, people couldn't afford to fight
each other. It was an era when they mustn't.
But even so, I think Argonaut would "forgive"!
theater_event_25_04_17_052:
No—I think he'd make some "other choice"
none of us could think of!
Just like in a comedy!
theater_event_25_04_17_054:
Maybe right now we're not allowed to believe
in pretty ideals. But we should still be allowed
to reach for them!
theater_event_25_04_17_055:
Instead of deciding "justice goes this far,"
if we reach past that sky, all the way to the
stars...maybe something will change.
theater_event_25_04_17_056:
(Not "how far justice goes," but challenging
 it endlessly...pressing on. Giving my all to
 the present. Right. Then what I need to do is—)
theater_event_25_04_17_057:
...Want to have that "nerd talk"
we promised?
theater_event_25_04_17_059:
"Come on, smile. Curl those lips.
 Tears don't suit a flower like you!"
theater_event_25_04_17_061:
..."I'll smile. However much they mock me,
however much they laugh, I'll curl my lips."
theater_event_25_04_17_062:
"Otherwise not even the spirits, or the
 goddess of fate, will smile on me!"
theater_event_25_04_17_063:
"—Ah, what a lovely smile! I've wanted to see it
 all this time! At last, I've made you smile!"
theater_event_25_04_17_064:
"Now, let us dance, fair maiden!
 Dance merrily and show me your smile!"
theater_event_25_04_17_065:
—Ahahaha! You kept right up with me!
You really are amazing, Al!
theater_event_25_04_17_066:
So are you, Ms. Ardee!
...Thank you, Ms. Ardee.
theater_event_25_04_17_067:
Mm-hm.
...If I could pay back even a little of what
you gave me, I'm happy!
theater_event_25_04_17_068: I'm glad I met you too, Al!
theater_event_25_04_17_070:
The Jester's happy face! A smile I want to
trample—er, hug—right now, and make bloody—
I mean, merry!
theater_event_25_04_17_071:
And the one making him smile like that is that
girl! More innocent than a fairy—a girl I want
to kill—I mean, to love!
theater_event_25_04_17_073:
What would happen if we plucked that "flower"
right in front of him? How much would he wail—
I mean, rejoice?!
theater_event_25_04_17_074:
Lovely, lovely! Oh, so lovely! I'm sure he'll
break oh so earnestly for us!
So much we won't be able to stop laughing!
theater_event_25_04_17_075:
The great King of Evil Gods gave us orders,
but let's break them.
We just can't hold back anymore!
theater_event_25_04_17_076:
Sister, let's use Olivas the White-Haired Demon!
We can at least set the city just a little
on fire and cause just a little chaos!
theater_event_25_04_17_077:
Good idea! Let's do that! We'll egg on that
useless junk—I mean, our not-so-cute toy—
and go steal the "flower"!
theater_event_25_04_18_002:
An enemy battalion is advancing from the city
wall's northwest! It's led by... Vendetta!
Enemy executive Olivas Act!!
theater_event_25_04_18_003: A large-scale raid?! At a time like this?!
theater_event_25_04_18_004:
This ain't the "harassment" we've been getting!
A change of plans... Or some unit gone rogue!
What a damn pain!
theater_event_25_04_18_007:
The raid on the northwest district! Ms. Ryu told
me about this! She said it was the hardest time,
after she lost Ms. Ardee!
theater_event_25_04_18_008:
But Ms. Ardee's alive, and Ms. Lion has moved on!
Things should be way better than in her story!
But still...!
theater_event_25_04_18_009:
(I've got a bad feeling about this...! No, I've
 felt someone's "gaze" this whole time! Like
 they're watching me, sneering at me...!)
theater_event_25_04_18_010:
We will drive back the enemy battalion! Rescuing
and protecting civilians is our top priority!
Adventurers Level 2 and up, under my command!
theater_event_25_04_18_011:
Ardee, take command of the healers
and support units in the rear!
theater_event_25_04_18_012:
Got it! Everyone, and you too, Al!
Be careful!
theater_event_25_04_18_014:
Shakti, we're taking the vanguard!
Everyone, follow me!!
theater_event_25_04_18_017:
Why are you staggering? Have you been drinking,
"Hunter"? Don't leave yourself open.
theater_event_25_04_18_018:
You're the one who's been showing off,
fighting all night every night. Don't you dare
say you're too beat to be any use.
theater_event_25_04_18_019:
Ms. Kaguya, Ms. Lyra...!
Yes, I'm fine!
theater_event_25_04_18_020:
(Ms. Kaguya and Ms. Lyra really are reliable!
 There's no way we lose with this lineup!
 And yet—)
theater_event_25_04_18_021: Where is this nasty "gaze" coming from...?!
theater_event_25_04_18_023: The Dis Sisters! But...only one of them?
theater_event_25_04_18_024: Where'd the dark elf run off to?!
theater_event_25_04_18_025:
Who knows! I won't say, and I won't tell!
So agonize all you like, Jester!
theater_event_25_04_18_027:
I've missed you! I've wanted to break you for
so, so long! I yearned for it even more than
killing—I mean, loving—Hogni!
theater_event_25_04_18_028:
It must be love at first sight! My irritation—my
heart's pounding—won't stop! So I'll torment—
entertain—you down to the depths of hell, Jester!
theater_event_25_04_18_029:
...You got some skill for attracting crazy women
or somethin'? You and that knife girl,
it's messed up.
theater_event_25_04_18_030:
I don't have any skill like that, and Ms. Hörn...
I mean, that's rude to Syr...!
theater_event_25_04_18_031:
(When Ms. Ryu fought this battle, were Dina
 and her sister here too...?! I can't tell!
 For now, I just have to hit them head-on!)
theater_event_25_04_19_002:
It's hot! It hurts!
Don't interrupt my waltz with the Jester!
theater_event_25_04_19_003:
Why would we not gang up on you, broken elf?
You may be Level 5, but the rest are a rabble
of nobodies,
theater_event_25_04_19_004:
your little sister isn't here, and you can't do
your precious teamwork. I don't know your aim,
but this is plainly a blunder.
theater_event_25_04_19_005:
Vendetta's tucking tail and running, y'know?
Go on, play the card you're saving—your sister.
theater_event_25_04_19_006:
(We've got her cornered... A Level 5,
 without backup from Master and the others.)
theater_event_25_04_19_007:
(—And yet she's smiling. Staring at me the whole
 time. Does she have something? What's coming?!)
theater_event_25_04_19_008:
All right. Then I'll show you a pretty "bouquet."
—Now, Vena♪
theater_event_25_04_19_011:
She ambushed the support unit?!
All by herself?!
theater_event_25_04_19_013:
Th-the support unit is out of action! But...
no pursuit from the enemy!
It looks like they avoided total annihilation!!
theater_event_25_04_19_014:
...? She didn't finish 'em off?
She threw away the perfect opening?
What the hell's going on?!
theater_event_25_04_19_016:
—Sister Dina!
I plucked the "flower," just like we promised!
theater_event_25_04_19_020:
Ahahahahaha! We stole it, Jester!
Your "flower"!!
theater_event_25_04_19_021:
They used their entire battalion as bait,
just to kidnap a single adventurer...?
Are they insane?!
theater_event_25_04_19_022:
There's no tactics, no strategy, no nothin'!
This is insane!! Just how broken are you?!
theater_event_25_04_19_023:
The maggots are saying something! How gross,
but who cares! We already got what we wanted!
theater_event_25_04_19_024:
Farewell, Jester!
We'll send you an invitation, so wait for it!
theater_event_25_04_19_025:
A viewing party where we tear your "flower" to
shreds! Heh heh, ahahahahahaha!!
theater_event_25_04_20_001:
The story is moving just as you told us.
But that doesn't mean it will end
exactly the way you told us.
theater_event_25_04_20_002:
In the world's history as you know it, "justice"
won. But it's clear that was a "miraculous
razor-thin margin."
theater_event_25_04_20_003:
In our world, too, justice and evil are evenly
matched. Even a small "deviation" could tip
the brimming scales the other way.
theater_event_25_04_20_004:
And you're no small "deviation."
You're a massive Irregular.
theater_event_25_04_20_005:
Please keep that in mind, Bell. Nothing is
preordained. In any "present," the unforeseen
will bare its fangs and bite—
theater_event_25_04_20_006:
Ms. Ardee is missing...
Those elves took her...
theater_event_25_04_20_007:
Lady Astraea and the others warned me!
That anything could happen! I let my guard down,
and because of that, Ms. Ardee—!
theater_event_25_04_20_009:
(If Master were here, he'd kick me for wasting
 time. Switch gears. Go cold. Just for now!)
theater_event_25_04_20_010:
I can't read those elves' minds. But they didn't
kill their hostage—Ms. Ardee—right away. They
must want to use her to make me suffer—
theater_event_25_04_20_011:
So she's alive. She can still live. And according
to Lord Ganesha, the number of his Falna
hasn't dropped. So there's still time—
theater_event_25_04_20_012:
Do I charge in before someone precious gets hurt?
I have no choice. It might wreck Lord Hermes's
plan. It might overturn everything.
theater_event_25_04_20_013:
Even so, this big idiot, Bell Cranel, can't throw
away the "one" for the "hundred." Mr. Finn is
here too. So is Master.
theater_event_25_04_20_014:
And Ms. Lion and the others. I'll lean on everyone
until they're sick of me. So even if a "trap"
awaits, I'll head into Knossos—
theater_event_25_04_20_016: —That's how he greeted me. Like a friend.
theater_event_25_04_20_017:
The one who appeared before me, as if born
from the darkness, was a god.
theater_event_25_04_20_018: The god said his name was "Eren."
theater_event_25_04_20_020:
"I'll guarantee her life. In exchange,
 you don't interfere any further."
theater_event_25_04_20_021: With that, he handed me a scrap of paper.
theater_event_25_04_20_022:
"The only freedom you're allowed is to visit
 the place written there, at the time
 written there."
theater_event_25_04_20_023:
When I asked if Ms. Ardee would be there,
the god smiled faintly and nodded.
theater_event_25_04_20_024:
"Go along with it, and I won't let Dina and her
 sister touch her. I'll make sure the deal holds.
 I swear it on the deep, dark Netherworld."
theater_event_25_04_20_025:
"A future where you clash with Silence and
 Gluttony was tempting too... But the Absolute
 Evil must honor his contracts."
theater_event_25_04_20_026:
"In return, behind the final clash of good and
 evil...show me the greatest comedy of all,
 one that will never be told."
theater_event_25_04_20_027:
I had no choice.
The god who called himself the Netherworld
said, with obvious delight:
theater_event_25_04_20_030:
The Dis Sisters probably acted outside his plan.
Even so, he used it without a second thought
and stole our "trump card."
theater_event_25_04_20_031:
In exchange for our joker, Bell, the card they
lost is the Dis Sisters. That might ease the
burden on the Freya Familia, but...
theater_event_25_04_20_032:
Giving us no choice, never letting us make
a fair trade—that's just like him.
theater_event_25_04_20_033:
Bell has no choice but to obey. He reads the
subtleties of a just heart frighteningly well.
Truly a god who can't be beaten at his game...
theater_event_25_04_20_034:
—But Bell is also a piece completely off
our board—an Irregular.
theater_event_25_04_20_035:
I know, Astraea.
A "City of Heroes" that leans on him for
everything would be a sorry sight.
theater_event_25_04_20_038:
Rescuing Ardee. He asked us to let him go alone.
"I'm sorry, but I'll save her for sure."
That's what he said.
theater_event_25_04_20_039:
The apology's uncalled for. What pisses me off
more is him thinking it's all on him alone.
We all got outplayed, every last one of us.
theater_event_25_04_20_040:
As I thought, I don't like that man.
He shows that pathetic face...yet he'll
surely pull it off anyway.
theater_event_25_04_20_041:
As her sister, I can't approve of her
dating him just yet, but...
theater_event_25_04_20_043:
Ahem!
...In any case, reluctant as I am,
I'll leave Ardee to that man.
theater_event_25_04_20_044:
With this "final battle" ahead,
we can't afford to split our forces.
theater_event_25_04_20_045:
Yes, let's win.
This "Battle of Good and Evil"!
theater_event_25_04_20_047:
The only script we want is the plan
of the "Absolute Evil" we made our pact with.
theater_event_25_04_20_048:
The world wants heroes. Then we'll build it one.
Once we've paid with everything we have,
a great foundation.
theater_event_25_04_20_049: If they can't surpass us, that is all.
theater_event_25_04_20_051:
"Justice comes around"...
I'll never let it end!
theater_event_25_04_21_002:
Full speed, force our way through! If they're in
the way, scatter 'em! Go, go, go!!
theater_event_25_04_21_004: We won't lose. No matter what.
theater_event_25_04_21_005:
Orario! City of Heroes, fallen to ruin
while we were gone!!
theater_event_25_04_21_006:
Satisfy me, prey! Make my blood boil
with your finest names, make my flesh dance!
theater_event_25_04_21_007: Now, let us devour each other.
theater_event_25_04_21_008:
The adventurers' song of reckless courage...
I am sick of hearing it. Orario is still Orario.
theater_event_25_04_21_009:
Very well. Then fall silent. Let the war cries
and the sound of life alike reach their final act.
theater_event_25_04_21_010: That is the only mercy I can offer now.
theater_event_25_04_21_012:
Hey, Vena, isn't Lord Erebus awful?
He says we can't snap this "flower"
we went to all the trouble of picking.
theater_event_25_04_21_013:
I know, Sister Dina! I wanted to play
"he loves me, he loves me not"! Gently plucking
her "petals" one by one to tell the future!
theater_event_25_04_21_014:
To see what face the Jester makes when he sees
her "petals"—her arms and legs—neatly scattered!
This "flower" only has to stay alive, after all!
theater_event_25_04_21_015:
True. And this "flower" is so noble!
No matter how we play with her, she won't make
a sound! See!
theater_event_25_04_21_017:
Sister Dina, you're so sloppy with your pranks!
I could make her cry! There!
theater_event_25_04_21_018:
Vena, you keep cheating!
Oh, I know, let's do it together!
theater_event_25_04_21_019:
Let's! As long as we don't kill—love—her,
we aren't breaking our promise
to the King of Evil Gods!
theater_event_25_04_21_022:
Ahahaha! She really won't cry or scream!
Amazing! Amazing, amazing! How lovely!
theater_event_25_04_21_024:
Hey. Isn't it time you cried pathetically?
We feel like total fools enjoying ourselves.
theater_event_25_04_21_025:
Being nobler and more beautiful than fairies like
us is not allowed. Absolutely not.
We will never accept such a thing.
theater_event_25_04_21_026:
We want to watch beautiful things fester, rot,
and fall. Make it messier! Filthier!
Spew your guts out!
theater_event_25_04_21_029:
You hate beautiful things...lovely things...
because you know you're not "fairies"
like Lion is...
theater_event_25_04_21_032:
Who cares about the evil god's orders! I'll kill
you right here!! I'll turn every last bit of you
into mush!!
theater_event_25_04_21_033:
We'll show your filthy corpse to the Jester!
He'll cry with regret! And we'll laugh at his
ugly, twisted face!!
theater_event_25_04_21_034:
So cry! Wail and make a pathetic spectacle!
This is the end, you know?!
This is your very last moment!!
theater_event_25_04_21_038:
"However much they mock me, however much
 they laugh...however much I despair,
 I'll curl my lips."
theater_event_25_04_21_039:
"Otherwise not even the spirits, or the
 goddess of fate, will smile on me!"
theater_event_25_04_21_041:
"Come on, smile! Curl those lips!
 Tears don't suit a flower like you!!"
theater_event_25_04_21_042:
What are you saying?
Smiling when you're about to die?!
Have you lost your mind?!
theater_event_25_04_21_043:
I won't cry! I'll smile and turn this into
a "comedy"! Because my favorite "clown"
is out there!!
theater_event_25_04_21_047: —I've been waiting for you, my Argonaut.
theater_event_25_04_22_001:
—Ahahahaha! All that bravado only lasts so long!
What's wrong, Jester?!
theater_event_25_04_22_002:
This is the Dungeon! There are monsters, too!
Look behind you! You'll get gobbled right up!
theater_event_25_04_22_004:
No, no, Jester!
No looking away!
theater_event_25_04_22_005: See—now there's a hole in you!!
theater_event_25_04_22_008:
I wanted to punch a hole in your neck, but it
hit your shoulder! Jester, you're like a
quick little rabbit!
theater_event_25_04_22_009:
But you're still no match for us! You're already
staggering! Hogni and the others are
far stronger than this!
theater_event_25_04_22_010:
Ngh...! "Rise, sacred stairway.
Shine, healing moonlight"—
Dia Kaumudi!
theater_event_25_04_22_011:
Healing magic?
Don't get in the way, you mere "flower"!
theater_event_25_04_22_015:
(The wound's closed. My Status went up, too.
 Must be Ms. Ardee's magic.
 —But I still can't win!)
theater_event_25_04_22_016:
(Two-on-one, the gap in strength—that's not even
 the problem! My body's heavy! My head's
 splitting! The exhaustion from no sleep...!)
theater_event_25_04_22_017:
(Before, I could fight for over two weeks with
 no sleep! It hasn't even been a week this time!
 So why does it hurt this much...?!)
theater_event_25_04_22_018:
(—No, of course it does. I fought a Level 7 all
 out. The toll is on another level. That first
 fight ate up a huge chunk of my time limit.)
theater_event_25_04_22_019:
(Two Level 5s with perfect teamwork. I can't beat
 that. And Ms. Ardee's too battered to fight.
 At this rate—)
theater_event_25_04_22_020: Bell, we'll entrust you with a "plan."
theater_event_25_04_22_021: (—I have no choice but to take a "gamble"...!)
theater_event_25_04_22_022: ...I heard what people say about you two.
theater_event_25_04_22_023: What do they say? What did you hear?!
theater_event_25_04_22_024:
A hymn singing our praises? Or some filthy
insult? We'd love to hear a lovely sacred
song of the forest!
theater_event_25_04_22_027: —You said it. You said that word.
theater_event_25_04_23_002:
Less a weakness than a "landmine." The moment
they hear the word "fiend," they stop being
innocent evil and turn into rampaging monsters.
theater_event_25_04_23_003:
Their teamwork won't fall apart and leave
openings, though. They attack so ferociously
they'll cover any gap and kill their target.
theater_event_25_04_23_004:
Whaaat...?!
Then what am I supposed to do...?
theater_event_25_04_23_005:
The Dis Sisters will always try to butcher anyone
who calls them "fiends." By any means
necessary, with every torment imaginable.
theater_event_25_04_23_006:
The regret and despair they try to carve
into you... That could be your only way
to break through.
theater_event_25_04_23_007: We are true "fairies," through and through!!
theater_event_25_04_23_008:
What makes us any different from other elves?!
Cruel!! Cruel!! Cruel!!
theater_event_25_04_23_010:
You won't die easy!
We'll break you, break you, break you to pieces!!
theater_event_25_04_23_011:
We'll make you regret calling us demons!
We'll carve wounds into your very soul
that will never heal!!
theater_event_25_04_23_012:
...You two...really do know.
That you're not beautiful...
theater_event_25_04_23_014:
That's why you go after Master...
and Mr. Hogni. You're jealous
of proud elves...
theater_event_25_04_23_015:
You envy beautiful people like Ms. Ardee...!
It hurts to look at them, so you try
to wipe them out...!
theater_event_25_04_23_016:
I want to kill him, kill him, kill him...
Hey, Sister, can't I?
Can't I kill him right now?!
theater_event_25_04_23_017:
Being killed by "fiends" like you doesn't bother
me one bit...! I'll stick my tongue out and go
back to the heavens knowing I was the pretty one!!
theater_event_25_04_23_019:
So going back to heaven unsullied is your sour
grapes? How unsightly! How grating!
What a shallow, utter fool!
theater_event_25_04_23_020:
—I'll paint over that foolish notion
along with "the brand of a sinner"!!
theater_event_25_04_23_021:
"—Rage, second garden! Rot sweetly,
ninth song!" Dialv Liminis!!
theater_event_25_04_23_022:
Ahahaha, she did it! Sister's prized curse!
Now he's our "charmed servant"!
What a fool you are, Jester!!
theater_event_25_04_23_024:
As the price, I'll be crazed with pleasure for a
while... But I'll let it out by knocking you
down, breaking you, gnawing and devouring you.
theater_event_25_04_23_025:
I'll use you, after you've snapped that
"flower" with your own hands!!
theater_event_25_04_23_027:
Kill her! Cruelly! Violate her down to her soul!!
And after that, I'll drive you, fallen to trash,
into the depths of despair!
theater_event_25_04_23_028:
I won't let you go back to heaven pure!!
Now, do it! You foolish clown!!
theater_event_25_04_23_031:
What is this...? Why aren't you moving?
—What on earth are you doing?!
theater_event_25_04_23_032:
You showed me your Status, didn't you, Bell?
I didn't mean anything by it...
but I happened to see "a certain skill."
theater_event_25_04_23_033:
That skill is your "chance to win." A power that
crushes only the Dis Sisters, with their Charm
magic eyes.
theater_event_25_04_23_034:
It's called Vanadis Tevere.
A skill completely specialized
against Charm.
theater_event_25_04_23_035:
Charm...the curse doesn't work?!
Don't tell me—he set us up?!
theater_event_25_04_24_001:
I cut him! I burn him! He heals right away!!
And on top of that, all his Status
is going up—?!
theater_event_25_04_24_002:
Level 5? No, Level 6?! Is he immortal?!
What is he, what IS this guy—?!
theater_event_25_04_24_003:
Ngh... Vena! Fall back!
We need to regroup—!
theater_event_25_04_24_011:
Al! Are you okay?!
You took such a beating... Are you hurt?!
theater_event_25_04_24_012:
I'm...okay... Thanks to a "skill,"
I heal on my own... More importantly,
what about you, Ms. Ardee?
theater_event_25_04_24_013:
I'm fine too. Wounds like these'll heal
in no time! Ah, ow, ow, ow...!
theater_event_25_04_24_014:
Don't push yourself...!
I still have some potions—
theater_event_25_04_24_016:
We lost, Sister... I'm so frustrated,
I want to curse him... But I think
we're finished...
theater_event_25_04_24_017:
Yes, Vena... We wanted to break so many
more things... We wanted to wreck
this whole world...
theater_event_25_04_24_018:
I won't forgive you, Jester...
...So hurry up and love—kill—us...
theater_event_25_04_24_019: ...What are you going to do, Al?
theater_event_25_04_24_020:
...Will you both promise me something?
That you'll never hurt anyone ever again—
theater_event_25_04_24_022:
Persecution, discrimination, segregation...
we've tasted all of it, down to hell's lowest pit.
We can't go to purgatory, and we won't...
theater_event_25_04_24_023:
We endured it all so we wouldn't break...
but so many races, the whole world,
kept breaking us...
theater_event_25_04_24_024:
There's nothing clean left in us anymore...
so we have to wash ourselves in blood and be
beautiful again... Beautiful "fairies"...
theater_event_25_04_24_026:
(—"Don't listen to them, foolish rabbit."
 That's what the Master in my heart is saying.)
theater_event_25_04_24_027:
There's no room for leniency. If the world
oppressed them, that debt has long been paid
by all the lives they've stolen.
theater_event_25_04_24_028:
No logic justifies slaughter that long ago
forgot its revenge. These rotten kin of mine
were "warped" from the start. That is all.
theater_event_25_04_24_029:
"So no matter how much they endured, they were
fated to break someday." So bury them. These
people are "evil"... That's what Master says.
theater_event_25_04_24_032:
In ancient times, people couldn't afford to fight
each other. It was an era when they mustn't.
But even so, I think Argonaut would "forgive"!
theater_event_25_04_24_033:
No—I think he'd make some "other choice"
none of us could think of!
Just like in a comedy!
theater_event_25_04_24_034:
I'm sorry, Master...
I want to choose this over the "justice"
that's been decided for me.
theater_event_25_04_24_035:
Idiot. You make me sick. How foolish can you be?
Don't use hypocrisy as your indulgence...
you idiot disciple.
theater_event_25_04_24_036: But I like you better that way, Bell—
theater_event_25_04_24_037:
...I guess that last part was just
my own wishful thinking...
theater_event_25_04_24_039:
Ms. Ardee...
I'm going to try choosing it...
the "other choice" you taught me.
theater_event_25_04_24_042:
We're beautiful "fairies"!
If we can just break the world,
we can go back to being "fairies"—
theater_event_25_04_24_043:
Then I'll acknowledge it. That you're beautiful,
lovely..."proud fairies."
theater_event_25_04_24_045:
So...
If you're "proud fairies," you'll keep
a promise, right?
theater_event_25_04_24_046:
Since I acknowledge you...please don't kill—
love—anyone else until you've finished
killing—loving—me.
theater_event_25_04_24_049:
I'll be the one who keeps saying you're
"always beautiful"... So please
don't cheat on me, okay?
theater_event_25_04_24_051: Heh heh, heh heh heh, ahahahahaha!
theater_event_25_04_24_052:
What a strange boy! What a strange boy!!
What a funny clown!!
I've never laughed this hard in my life!
theater_event_25_04_24_053:
Fine, we'll keep it! Because we're not "fiends,"
we're "fairies"! We'll keep this sacred,
noble vow forever!!
theater_event_25_04_24_054: Forever, until death do us part!!
theater_event_25_04_24_056:
I'll be the one to kill—love—you,
no matter what! Jester!
theater_event_25_04_24_057:
No, Sister Dina! I'm the one who gets
to kill—love—him!
theater_event_25_04_24_058: Let me have him, Vena! I'm the big sister!
theater_event_25_04_24_061:
The two of them laughed themselves to sleep...
We'll carry them to the Guild later...
and they'll probably be locked up, so...
theater_event_25_04_24_063:
I know I said "another choice," but come on!
Ah, but my own take on Argonaut would do
something similar...! Is this a true comedy?!
theater_event_25_04_24_064:
Talking them down by sacrificing yourself
might be amazing...! But I knew it,
Al really is a womanizer...!
theater_event_25_04_24_065:
(...? Ms. Ardee's saying something...but I
 can't make it out... Was it bad to make a
 promise like that when I'm going to vanish...?)
theater_event_25_04_24_066:
(Huh...? But according to Lady Astraea, there's
 a "Bell Cranel" in this "dream"
 who isn't me...?)
theater_event_25_04_24_067:
(No, but the one who promised is me,
 "Bell Cranel"... Ugh, it's no good, I'm so
 sleepy my head's not working—)
theater_event_25_04_24_069:
Was that...a monster's howl?!
But I've never heard such a terrifying cry!
theater_event_25_04_24_070:
The operation to slay the Calamity...
on the 18th floor...
And this is the 20th floor...
theater_event_25_04_24_072: I felt like someone—a fairy—had told me.
theater_event_25_04_24_073:
That "the Strongest Witch" fought in the Dungeon,
then fell into a hole and vanished.
theater_event_25_04_24_074:
I remembered that... I don't really know why.
My head wasn't working either, so maybe there
wasn't a reason at all.
theater_event_25_04_24_075: I just—as if something, fate, had pushed me—
theater_event_25_04_24_076:
Al?!
Where are you going, Al?!
theater_event_25_04_24_077:
(—I'm almost at my limit. My body won't last.
 Which means the time I have left is—)
theater_event_25_04_24_078: Then—just one more time, the "other choice"...
theater_event_25_04_25_002:
I have decided my body will return to ash...
Just like that child...
theater_event_25_04_25_003:
Farewell, Familia of justice.
Farewell, Orario.
theater_event_25_04_25_006: At last, I am coming to you—
theater_event_25_04_25_014:
What you asked me...
in the church...
theater_event_25_04_25_015:
Go see the one you love...
...and save the world too.
theater_event_25_04_25_017:
Don't give up... Make "another choice"...
Even if it isn't ideal... a comedy where
you and someone else can smile...
theater_event_25_04_25_022:
I was scared we'd have to say goodbye again,
so I couldn't say it! But...!
theater_event_25_04_25_024:
Next time we meet...
I'll tell you who, okay?
theater_event_25_04_25_027:
Thank you for giving me my life,
and for coming to save me!
theater_event_25_04_25_028:
I might forget, but even so, I'll never forget!
—So see you again! Al!!
theater_event_25_04_25_030:
I bet you and I will both forget "him"!
But what he gave us won't disappear!
theater_event_25_04_25_031:
So you go see the one you love, too!
—You have to keep on living, you hear me?!
theater_event_25_04_25_032:
The battle later known as the Great Feud
was over.
theater_event_25_04_25_033:
The evil god was sent back, and justice won
the clash of good and evil.
More or less "as the Jester foretold."
theater_event_25_04_25_034:
The new strongest defeated the Conqueror,
and the Familia of justice defeated the Witch.
theater_event_25_04_26_003:
My room...?! The Hestia Familia's home!
I'm back?! Then—
theater_event_25_04_26_004:
Did the future change?!
Are Ms. Alise and the others alive?!
I have to find out—!
theater_event_25_04_26_006:
Bell? What's the matter?
Why are you in such a hurry?
theater_event_25_04_26_007: Ms. Ryu! Ms. Alise and the others!
theater_event_25_04_26_009: Are Ms. Alise and the others...alive?
theater_event_25_04_26_010:
...What are you talking about, Bell?
Alise and the others are gone.
theater_event_25_04_26_013:
(A "dream"... All of that was a "dream"...
 ...I see. ...Of course it was.)
theater_event_25_04_26_014:
(There's no way I went back to the past...
 It really was just my imagination, a "dream"...)
theater_event_25_04_26_015:
...Bell.
Would you like to come visit Alise and
the others with me?
theater_event_25_04_26_017:
I was planning to go to the 18th floor today.
And to visit Ardee, too.
theater_event_25_04_26_018:
I'd like to introduce you to everyone properly.
What do you say?
theater_event_25_04_26_019:
Ah... Yes! I'll go!
Please let me come with you!
theater_event_25_04_26_020:
Then please wait a moment.
I'll get ready.
theater_event_25_04_26_021:
......Even if that was just a "dream,"
I'll never forget what I saw and heard there.
theater_event_25_04_26_024: What are you doing out here?
theater_event_25_04_26_026:
It's like someone was cut out of an illustration...
I was tracing that blank white outline,
and I ended up here.
theater_event_25_04_26_028:
They made enormous contributions in the Great
Feud and have become a legend, yet no one
can remember them.
theater_event_25_04_26_029:
Not even whether it was a man or a woman.
...Even though they must have helped me
so many times...
theater_event_25_04_26_030:
It's lonely, isn't it? Sad, and it
makes your heart ache. But...
theater_event_25_04_26_032:
As long as I have this...
someday, after everything comes around,
I'll meet them again. That's how I feel.
theater_event_25_04_26_033:
......I wonder if "you" got to meet
yours?
theater_event_25_04_26_035:
I have decided to live in shame
a little longer.
theater_event_25_04_27_001:
...I'm heading out, Grandpa.
Watch over me from the sky.
theater_event_25_04_27_005:
You already crushed it!!!
My head, my heeead!!?
theater_event_25_04_27_006:
How many times must I tell you?
What did I tell you to call me? Hm?
theater_event_25_04_27_008:
Do not send me up to the heavens alongside
that lecherous old baboon, you fool.
theater_event_25_04_27_009:
No, I wasn't sending you up to the sky,
Mother Alfia... I just hoped you'd watch over
me quietly and peacefully...
theater_event_25_04_27_010:
What are you trying to say? Not enough training
yet? Then we shall postpone your departure
for Orario.
theater_event_25_04_27_014:
Five years ago, broken elves escaped from Bergen,
the City of Sinners. You will almost certainly be
targeted, I have a feeling, so be on guard.
theater_event_25_04_27_015:
You told me before, but I really don't get it...
Why would elves I've never even met
be after me...?
theater_event_25_04_27_016:
To them, courtship is death. After all the training
I gave you, if you get killed, I will come
kick you myself. Be ready.
theater_event_25_04_27_017: But why?! And please don't kick my corpse!
theater_event_25_04_27_021:
...So go save the world already,
while I am still alive.
theater_event_25_04_27_025:
A quiet, lonely dream of solitude, somewhere
far, far away from here—
theater_event_25_04_27_026:
That was probably another me,
one who might have been...
theater_event_25_04_27_027: But now I, on that "Day of Twilight"—
theater_event_25_04_27_029:
An old dream where something I can no longer
remember persuaded me to go see that child—
theater_event_25_04_27_030:
On that "Day of Twilight" painted by the dusk—
our fate changed.
theater_event_25_04_27_031:
Pushed forward by that dream, I am who I am now...
We are who we are now.
theater_event_25_04_27_032: That was a dream of silence, far, far away.
theater_event_25_04_27_033:
This is a dream of serenity, far, far away—
its continuation.
theater_event_25_04_27_035: —into the unknown future beyond the dream.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_03:
For tomorrow's War Game,
I'll wear this dress.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_06:
...It's the first time I've seen
you in that garment.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_07:
My. I don't even know how many dresses
I've worn. You remember every one of them?
theater_fre_quest_02_01_08: If I've seen it with my own eyes, yes.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_10:
You're right, Ottar.
Today is the first time I've put on this dress.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_11:
I had it made a long time ago.
It's been gathering dust all this while.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_12: But tomorrow, at last, I can wear it.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_13: Does it hold some special meaning?
theater_fre_quest_02_01_14:
"Meaning" is far too grand a word.
It's simply my "longing."
theater_fre_quest_02_01_16:
Even I have such things.
Though I've never told anyone before.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_19:
Aww, Mama Mia, you're so mean~
We finally got back to the pub, so let me
take a little break~
theater_fre_quest_02_01_20:
What are you talking about?
This is your fault for forgetting the shopping.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_21:
Well, yeah, but... It's the first time I've ever
carried that much stuff, you know?
My hands are still tingling.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_22:
Don't be so pathetic.
You didn't even carry half of what I did.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_23:
You might be fine, Mama Mia, but~...
I'm just a frail little employee.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_24:
If you're an employee, earn your wages.
Come on. We've got two more trips to make.
theater_fre_quest_02_01_25:
Whaaat?! My arms will get all buff!
It's not like I'm a certain Warlord or something...
Hm?
theater_fre_quest_02_01_27:
Oh, right, someone said there was a wedding
today. So it was at this church, huh?
theater_fre_quest_02_02_02:
Sniff... I'm so happy...
To think I get to be with you like this...
I-I'm just...
theater_fre_quest_02_02_03:
Geez, why are you crying first?!
I'm so happy I could cry too!!
theater_fre_quest_02_02_05:
...Apparently those two are childhood friends.
Word is they've loved each other since
they were kids.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_06:
Neither of them ever took another lover,
so folks were calling it a "pure love,"
the kind you rarely see these days.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_08:
If you think it exists, I suppose it does.
You think it doesn't?
theater_fre_quest_02_02_09:
I don't know.
But I think it'd be nice if it did.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_10:
Feelings so pure they're practically clear,
not stained by any color at all.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_11:
Pure white, like the wedding dress she's wearing.
If I could feel that way about someone...
theater_fre_quest_02_02_12:
...Hmph. What's this?
You sound just like some ordinary young girl.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_13:
Is that...weird?
I'm a perfectly ordinary town girl, you know?
theater_fre_quest_02_02_14: Oh, that's right. Slipped my mind.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_15:
You were huffing and puffing, couldn't carry
a single bag, so I mistook you for some
princess or something.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_16:
That's just because I'm frail, isn't it?
Isn't that attitude a problem for an employer?
theater_fre_quest_02_02_17:
Oh, pipe down already.
Come on, let's go. We won't make it in time
for the evening opening.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_19:
Bound to each other by pure feelings,
and blessed like that by everyone around them...
theater_fre_quest_02_02_23:
Why would I lie? Not even the gods know what'll
happen in this world. Right?
theater_fre_quest_02_02_25:
But even if someone like that shows up,
whether they'll accept your feelings is
a whole other matter.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_26:
Yeah. I'm sure that's true.
But I probably wouldn't want to give up.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_27: If someone like that showed up, I'd—
theater_fre_quest_02_02_28: —make them mine, no matter what it takes.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_30:
This dress is my feelings themselves.
The same as the one that bride wore that day.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_31:
My pure white, pure feelings for "him."
There isn't a single lie in them.
theater_fre_quest_02_02_32:
Tomorrow—I will accept "him."
Becoming pure white, just like "him."
